annotations.title: Get App Store and Google Play analytics (Appfigures)

description: Store-reported numbers synced from Appfigures: downloads, re-downloads, updates, uninstalls, store revenue after the store's cut (subscriptions, in-app purchases, ads), top countries, the ratings snapshot, recent reviews with text, and category chart positions. Money is in micros of `currency`. Store revenue is a separate figure from RevenueCat revenue; never add the two. Returns connected: false when Appfigures is not set up.

reviews.description: How many recent reviews to include, default 20
